dehydrated_text: This project aims to address the issue of high energy consumption in smart homes by developing an AI system that can efficiently manage household appliances. Specifically, the system will learn from user behavior patterns and predict energy usage trends. Through machine learning algorithms, it will optimize appliance schedules to reduce unnecessary power consumption without compromising comfort or convenience. For instance, during off-peak hours, the system might delay the start of a dishwasher until there is enough dirty dishes accumulated, thus saving electricity.
